dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Closed-loop 'O' and 'C' structures with sharp gradient transitions from dark exterior boundaries to light-beige interior centers, displaying irregular and jagged perimeter geometry concentrated in the mid-body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of solid light-colored pixel clusters without internal gradients located primarily on the anterior-dorsal region and scattered along the posterior-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle oriented longitudinally along the dorsal ridge.
